description: This file defines the HeaderAbiDiff class for comparing ABI differences between two versions of a library, including methods for collecting symbols, types, and generating compatibility reports.

classes.name: HeaderAbiDiff
classes.description: A class for analyzing and generating reports on ABI differences between two library versions.

methods.name: HeaderAbiDiff
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ABI diff analysis with library details, dump files, and options.

methods.name: GenerateCompatibilityReport
methods.description: Generates a report indicating ABI compatibility status.

methods.name: CompareTUs
methods.description: Compares two translation units for ABI differences.

methods.name: CollectDynsymExportables
methods.description: Collects exportable symbols from dynamic symbol tables.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Collects elements and symbols from old and new versions.

methods.name: CollectElfSymbols
methods.description: Collects ELF symbols from symbol maps.

methods.name: PopulateElfElements
methods.description: Populates ELF symbol elements for diffing.

methods.name: PopulateRemovedElements
methods.description: Populates elements that are present in old but not in new version.

methods.name: PopulateCommonElements
methods.description: Populates elements common to both versions.

methods.name: DumpLoneElements
methods.description: Outputs elements present only in one version.

methods.name: ExtractUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Extracts user-defined types from a module.

methods.name: CollectUserDefinedTypes
methods.description: Collects user-defined types from old and new modules.

methods.name: CollectUserDefinedTypesInternal
methods.description: Internal method for collecting user-defined types.
